confidence_notes: Food and drink anchors are bounded from aggregator estimates for La Spezia (Combien Coute, WhereAndWhen, Expatica/Numbeo, 2026) and Genoa bar listings. Cocktail and wine are weaker, so they use Genoa data and beer-relative judgment. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates for July high season, not checked against live listings. The FX observation (18 Nov 2026) was surfaced by search results for the RBA exchange-rates overview page, not read directly from the RBA site. EUR-to-USD for the anchors uses about 1.10, implied from third-party AUD/USD and AUD/EUR quotes.
comparable_city_reasoning: Liguria regional basis, benchmarked to La Spezia aggregator price data and Genoa bar prices. Accommodation reflects general knowledge of mid-sized Italian coastal cities in peak summer season.
